goal: Distributed rate limits and abuse defense across sensitive endpoints.
summary: Implemented and verified production-grade distributed sliding-window rate limiting and abuse defense: (1) Added RateLimitEntry model in backend/models.py and strictly additive Alembic migration 0072_distributed_rate_limiting.py with indexes on (key, created_at); (2) Created backend/services/rate_limiter.py with DistributedRateLimiter utilizing PostgreSQL transactional advisory locks (pg_advisory_xact_lock) for absolute atomicity across competing processes and workers; (3) Hardened visitor inquiry submissions in backend/routers/rbpc.py to strictly enforce max 5 requests per IP/hour; (4) Hardened authentication login in backend/routers/auth.py to enforce max 5 attempts per minute per IP and per account, neutralizing distributed botnets and credential-stuffing attacks; (5) Hardened AI query endpoints (/api/v1/ai/tutor, /api/v1/ai/qa, /api/v1/ai/summary) with sliding-window quota limits per IP and per user; (6) Enforced standard HTTP 429 Too Many Requests responses with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-* headers and structured error envelopes; (7) Verified negative abuse defense: concurrent worker threads and HTTP burst requests are serialized and cannot bypass the global rate limit ceiling.

files_modified.changes: Added RateLimitEntry model mapped to rate_limit_entries table with composite index idx_rate_limit_entries_key_created_at.
Created additive Alembic migration creating rate_limit_entries table and its indexes, verified by CI migration safety preflight.

Implemented DistributedRateLimiter class featuring sliding-window request counting, PostgreSQL 64-bit advisory locking (pg_advisory_xact_lock), thread locks, opportunistic cleanup, and endpoint helper functions.
Integrated distributed rate limiter into create_rbpc_inquiry to enforce 5 requests per IP/hour with backwards-compatible test resets.
Integrated distributed rate limiter into login endpoint enforcing max 5 attempts per minute per IP and per user account.
Integrated distributed rate limiter into ai_tutor, ai_qa, and ai_summary enforcing query quota limits per IP and per user.
Added auth_login_rate_limit_per_minute configuration setting defaulting to 5.
Enhanced _auth_rate_limit_state dictionary subclass to support clean in-memory state resets in tests.
Added rate_limit_entries table creation and missing users.school_id column check to engine fixture.

Implemented 7 comprehensive tests covering IP-level limits, account-level limits, multi-IP distributed brute force defense, AI query quotas, sliding-window expiration, and negative abuse concurrency ceilings.

invariants_verified.inquiry_submissions_rate_limit: Inquiry submissions (/api/v1/rbpc/inquiries) are strictly throttled to max 5 per IP/hour. 6th submission receives HTTP 429.
invariants_verified.auth_login_per_ip_and_account: Authentication login (/api/v1/auth/login) enforces max 5 attempts per minute per IP and per account. 6th attempt receives HTTP 429.
invariants_verified.distributed_brute_force_thwarted: Attacks distributing attempts across 5 distinct IPs targeting a single victim account are blocked at the account level on the 6th attempt.
invariants_verified.ai_query_quota_limits: AI query endpoints (/api/v1/ai/*) enforce sliding-window query limits per minute per IP and per user account.
invariants_verified.http_429_retry_after_error_envelope: Standard HTTP 429 Too Many Requests response with Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit, and X-RateLimit-Remaining headers, and error envelope {'error': {'code': 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', ...}}.
invariants_verified.negative_abuse_ceiling_enforced: PostgreSQL transactional advisory locks (pg_advisory_xact_lock) guarantee that concurrent worker threads and burst HTTP requests cannot bypass the global rate limit ceiling.
